section.p: Result: The converter promotes the highest heading level present to the <h1> role. Each promoted heading generates a .ditamap and a corresponding .dita topic file. The root Ditamap title comes from the index file title or ZIP folder name, not the HTML content.
section.note: The converter promotes the highest heading level present when no <h1> is found, ensuring content is still converted. For best results, always begin each HTML file with a single <h1> to make the hierarchy explicit.
